summary: First-run E2E test of MirrorStream (backend + frontend). All 18 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend Playwright walk-through of register→dashboard→create mirror→public embed→admin login→admin tabs all worked. Country-based host sorting verified via API (ES: VOE 12 > Dood 11; US: VOE 40 > Dood 33) and visually in the embed page (US badge, VOE tab first).

issues: iframe area has white background inside a dark themed player when a host URL is unreachable (404). Cosmetic only - real embed URLs will render normally.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py login_attempts lockout also SETS locked_until on the very first failed attempt (before the count reaches 5) - functionally fine because gate is count>=5, but data model is slightly misleading.
list_hosts requires auth even though embed player is public; not a bug since embed endpoint already returns enriched host info, but /api/hosts being auth-only is fine.
public_mirror strips _id but not password_hash on user docs elsewhere; get_current_user does strip it. OK.
seed() rewrites /app/memory/test_credentials.md on every startup which is intentional per playbook.
test_credentials: admin@mirrorstream.com / Admin@1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). New users created dynamically via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ created via registration; test mirrors titled TEST_* created and (mostly) cleaned up by delete test. One UI-created mirror TEST_UI_Movie remains for admin panel demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~4s with pytest-xdist. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Public embed accepts ?country=XX to override IP geolocation. data-testid attributes are present on all key UI elements.
